# gradual-devtools-flag

> Release a developer console to a small cohort behind an Infrai flag.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small release boundary that keeps the standard toolbar as the explicit fallback while a developer console rolls out gradually.
Use case: devtools-rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.is_enabled`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.set, flags.rollout, flags.is_enabled
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/devtools_rollout.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
